northpoints: Become the strongest practical Minecraft mod updater, diagnosis, correction, compatibility, upgrade, and downgrade system available.
Prefer exact evidence from artifacts, source, mappings, APIs, dependency graphs, and real runtime behavior over filenames or metadata guesses.
Preserve originals, stage every mutation, prove every repair, and retain rollback evidence.
Consume the strongest current stable and bleeding-edge tooling while hardening useful experimental technology instead of discarding it by default.
featurePillars: Durable Repair Brain and research memory
Official Version Atlas and toolchain intelligence
Offline SQLite Compatibility Brain with full-text repair search
Immutable source intake and controlled wrapper execution
Isolated Porting Lab workspaces and cryptographic duplicate repair
Always-updated cross-platform Creator Vault with evidence-backed YouTube/TikTok recommendation extraction
Creator-controlled link-hub intelligence that discovers and refreshes modpacks, packs, socials, downloads and support links with provenance and safe fetch boundaries
Evidence-backed multi-pack Creator Modpack Library that enumerates all verified CurseForge/Modrinth releases and collaborations without fabricating ownership
Hot-droppable creator evidence catalogs that feed the real Creator Vault without creator-specific hardcoding or application rebuilds
guardrails: A metadata edit is not a port.
A successful remap, patch, build, or startup is not completion.
Runtime bridges require target-mod and workload verification.
Downgrades require explicit reverse transforms and loss analysis.
Never remove unrelated working behavior or weaken tests to make a result pass.
acceptanceSignals: A complete source migration receipt with file-level edits, logs, hashes, artifacts, rollback, and proof bundle
Fresh-package UI verification for both installed-JAR and source-project repair workflows
Followed creators survive restart, backfill once, refresh incrementally, and preserve speech/visual-text provenance for every resolved or unresolved mod mention

Followed creator profiles automatically discover public link hubs and creator modpack destinations, keep exact evidence/first-last-seen provenance, never crawl arbitrary outbound sites, retain last-known-good links on provider failure, and expose exact-destination UI controls

Followed creators expose every verifiable provider modpack with owner/member/direct/profile provenance, refresh the library over time, preserve last-known-good data on provider failure, and show an explicit no-verified-pack state when evidence is absent

Creator catalog bundles can be dropped or updated at runtime, merge into existing archive state without downgrading stronger live evidence, preserve truthful coverage/provenance, and survive malformed updates/restart.
